ion. 1.6.3 Delivered product shall integrate A-GRA autonomy interface into the existing MTS Service Set creation tool. Upon selection of A-GRA, the Mission Planner Autonomy UI must dynamically reconfigure connection parameter fields (e.g., IPs, Ports, Serial) to match the A- GRA interface format and auto -populate with appropriate default values. Programme Aim The purpose of this training programme is to design, develop and deliver a training programme that build people’s understanding of self-harm and the role it plays in the life of a person who self-harms. The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. Programme Objectives The training programme is intended to: Increase understanding of what self-harm is. Increase understanding of the relationship between self-harm and suicide. Build skills and confidence to engage with a person and speak openly about self-harm. Challenge the stigma surrounding self-harm Increase awareness of available supports and services Stage 1: An introduction to the subject of self-harm – communicating the ‘why’ functions of self-harm through lived experience experts. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. The GUI shall be designed to allow an operator with basic TDL knowledge to achieve proficiency on core tasks in no more than three (3) standard working days. nual data entry. 3.1.3 Data and Issue Management: • 3.1.3.1 Management of TDL Differences: The software shall allow users to capture, document, and grade deviations from a standard TDL baseline directly within a platform's implementation record. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. Le contrat avec autorisations de tâches (AT) est une méthode d'approvisionnement de services selon laquelle l'ensemble ou une portion des travaux sont réalisés « selon la demande ». Dans le cadre de contrats avec AT, le travail à réaliser peut être défini, mais la nature et les échéances précises des services, des activités et des produits livrables requis ne sont connus qu'au moment où le service est demandé pendant la durée du contrat. L'AT est un outil administratif structuré grâce auquel la Couronne autorise un entrepreneur à effectuer les travaux « selon la demande », conformément aux modalités du contrat. Les AT ne sont pas des contrats individuels. PROGRAMME DES MARCHANDISES CONTRÔLÉES La présente demande d’offres est assujettie au Programme des marchandises contrôlées (PMC).
